content: {"summary":"On 24 March 2026 inventory‑service pods could not resolve their database hostname while datastore VMs could. The two internal DNS servers that serve the prod.internal zone can temporarily diverge during a rollout. Pods query the cluster CoreDNS which forwards each request randomly to one of the two servers, caching the answer for up to 30 s. If one server is missing the record, a pod may receive an NXDOMAIN (reported as “no such host”) and keep that negative answer in cache, whereas VMs always query the primary server first and only fall back if it fails, so they still obtain the correct record. This mismatch explains the different behavior.","likely_cause":"A zone rollout left one of the internal DNS servers without the inventory‑db‑01 record, and pods’ random forwarding caused them to see the missing record while VMs queried the server that still had it.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Two internal DNS servers are authoritative for the prod.internal zone.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#1"],"quote":"two servers are authoritative for it: - internal-dns-01.prod.internal (10.0.0.53) - internal-dns-02.prod.internal (10.0.0.54)"},{"text":"VMs resolve using the first DNS server listed in /etc/resolv.conf and fall back only if it fails.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#2"],"quote":"VMs list both servers in `/etc/resolv.conf`, internal-dns-01 first."},{"text":"Pods use the cluster CoreDNS forward plugin which picks an upstream at random for each query.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#3"],"quote":"The `forward` plugin picks an upstream at random for each query it sends."},{"text":"If one DNS server lacked the inventory-db-01 record during a rollout, pods could receive NXDOMAIN while VMs succeeded, causing the observed discrepancy.","evidence_ids":["RB-020#10","RB-020#3","RB-020#2"],"quote":"Record missing on one or both servers."}],"next_checks":["Run dig against both internal‑dns‑01 and internal‑dns‑02 for inventory-db-01.prod.internal to compare answers and SOA serials","Check the rollout logs to see if a zone update was in progress on 24 Mar 2026","Inspect CoreDNS logs on both DNS VMs for errors or SERVFAIL responses at that time","Verify that /etc/resolv.conf on the inventory‑service pods points to the cluster CoreDNS and not directly to the internal DNS servers"]}
